The pinned CTI file is the unmodified public Burke, Chaos, Ju, Dryer and
Klippenstein hydrogen mechanism, version 6-10-2011, distributed by
Subspace-Lab/CollectionOfMechanisms at commit
202dd972cf83583570a1090864e3fa3c8ddb5be5.

Original path: Hydrogen_H2/Burke_et_al_2012/h2_burke2012.cti
The collection's MIT LICENSE and exact Git blob/SHA256 hashes accompany it.
The source's attribution, copyright and N2-bath-gas choice are preserved.
Reference: Burke et al., Comprehensive H2/O2 Kinetic Model for High-Pressure
Combustion, International Journal of Chemical Kinetics (2012),
https://doi.org/10.1002/kin.20603

Generated YAML is a conversion, not an unmodified upstream artifact.
The H2_air10 variant removes HE, CO and CO2, which remain identically zero
for these H2/air cases, and the explicit HE collider channels. Production
rate and enthalpy equivalence to the full release are checked independently.
Its 25 retained Cantera rate entries must not be described as the exact
20-reaction file cited by Kumar: that author's specific file was not released.
